headline: North Mississippi Health Services names new Chief Operating Officer; routine leadership transition

signals.summary: North Mississippi Health Services announced Shawn Morrow as new Chief Operating Officer in mid-July 2026. Leadership transitions present a potential touchpoint for vendor re-introduction, but COO appointments do not typically trigger immediate platform needs.
signals.suggestedAction: Monitor for broader operational changes or technology initiatives from new COO over next 60 days; flag for outreach if new leadership commences tech or security review.

headline: NMHS expands physical footprint with new medical office building; names new chief legal officer

signals.summary: North Mississippi Health Services opened a new medical office building, indicating geographic and operational expansion.
signals.suggestedAction: Reach out to the facilities/IT leadership to understand the new building's staffing and email infrastructure needs. Offer a brief discovery call to map new seat count and discuss email security posture across the expanded footprint.

signals.summary: NMHS appointed a new chief legal officer, bringing fresh leadership to compliance and legal functions.
signals.suggestedAction: Monitor for introduction window. After a reasonable onboarding period (4-6 weeks), send a brief email introducing Paubox's compliance and retention features relevant to healthcare legal operations, positioning it as a vendor review conversation.
